SHIVAM EPOXY FLOORING — COMPLIANCE IMPLEMENTATION REVIEW
Date: 13 November 2026
Scope: the new custom Sites/Cloudflare website. The old Hostinger site/domain has not been replaced or deleted.
Status: implemented safeguards and draft policies; NOT a legal certification. Unconfirmed particulars remain visible as placeholders.

DONE
- Privacy Policy, Terms of Service, Cancellation & Refund Policy, Cookie Policy, B2C Service Terms, B2B Project Terms and Business/Contact page.
- Permanent compact footer: trading name, supplied address, Business & Contact link and privacy/opt-out links. Unconfirmed legal identity, GST/Udyam particulars remain clearly described on Business & Contact and relevant policies, not as public template placeholders repeated in every footer. No timed hiding of disclosures. The public age-18+ service label has been removed; adult eligibility is limited to bookings/contracts, not browsing. Footer legal navigation uses Terms & Conditions, Privacy Policy and an expandable More policies menu; cookie preferences remain directly accessible. GST status is reported as unregistered, not an exemption; no identifier invented.
- Necessary enquiry information only: name, phone and service; city, area and notes optional. Redundant preferred-finish field removed. Exact address/photos requested only when needed in the later project discussion.
- Enquiry checkbox: specific enquiry-contact purpose, with no age declaration. No promotional subscription. Form prepares a message locally; user must send it in WhatsApp/email.
- Standalone WhatsApp links require a clear external-service consent dialog. Cancel and keyboard Escape available; no marketing opt-in bundled with service contact.
- Owner photo uploads require publication-rights/permission confirmation. API enforces it. Replaced/reset managed photos are deleted from active R2 storage; media cache reduced to 5 minutes. Historic orphan/default assets/backups still need a retention review.
- Cookie Accept/Reject/Manage, no pre-ticked optional boxes. No optional trackers configured. Current choices leave analytics/marketing off. Cookie preferences can be reopened from every public-page footer.
- Correction/deletion and promotional opt-out email links. WhatsApp STOP instructions; business must maintain operational suppression records. No newsletter/marketing automation installed.
- Included site-visit/transport charges and project-specific 40–80% advance disclosed. Refund rule records supplier-return credits and flags the 10%-of-total-quote deduction for legal review.
- Waterproofing 2–10-year warranty separated from the owner-confirmed 1–3-year epoxy/PU peeling warranty; B2B DLP remains unresolved. Own preparation/workmanship is not subject to a blanket moisture exclusion; mandatory rights preserved.
- Product-specific document request links. No fabricated TDS/SDS downloads or test/certification claims.
- Skip links, visible focus, native keyboard-operable dialogs, links, forms and checkboxes. New policy/consent text and controls use tested AA-contrast colour pairs.
- Existing content/layout/colours retained except necessary legal additions, consent/field changes, claim notes and accessible small-text adjustments.

THIRD-PARTY / SCRIPT INVENTORY AND RECOMMENDATION
1. /photo-content.js — first-party saved-photo loader. KEEP as necessary website functionality; reads the same-origin photo manifest. No enquiry submission/tracking.
2. /compliance.js — first-party consent/preferences and WhatsApp contact dialog. KEEP. Stores only the cookie-choice record; no analytics or advertising SDK.
3. DM Sans — formerly Google Fonts @import. REMOVED external font requests; KEEP local font files at /assets/fonts/ and the SIL Open Font License (OFL.txt).
4. Unsplash — unused preconnect REMOVED. Three unused local stock-image assets REMOVED. Do not restore stock/Google images without an appropriate licence and correct description.
5. Google Analytics, Tag Manager, Meta Pixel, embedded Maps/chat SDK and newsletter provider — NOT FOUND in audited application code. Do not install optional tools without an updated inventory and consent-gated loading where required. Hosting-injected tools have not been independently inventoried.
6. WhatsApp/Meta — click-through link after enquiry contact consent; not an embedded SDK. KEEP as an optional contact route. Recipient: +91 95698 37456.
7. Email — mailto handoff, no email SDK/server marketing list in this site. KEEP. Recipient: shivamvish101@gmail.com.
8. Google Maps, Instagram, Facebook, YouTube — ordinary user-activated links; not embeds. KEEP as links. External destinations use their own policies.
9. Observed provider cookie: __cf_bm on the hosted response, used for bot/security checks; documented 30-minute inactivity lifetime. Other auth cookies/retention remain to verify. Reference: https://developers.cloudflare.com/fundamentals/reference/policies-compliances/cloudflare-cookies/
10. OpenAI/ChatGPT Sites identity + Cloudflare Workers/R2/assets — essential hosting, authentication and storage infrastructure. KEEP; verify vendor terms, processing locations, actual cookies, log/back-up retention and access configuration before domain switch.

IMAGES, CLAIMS AND DARK-PATTERN AUDIT
- No testimonials/review scores, countdowns, fake urgency, pre-ticked optional consent, or forced marketing subscriptions were found in the audited page code.
- Two industrial hall/workspace illustrations have now been replaced with supplied Pixel-camera originals from the ZIP. The supplied waterproofing collage remains an illustration, not verified completed-project photography; an original waterproofing photo is still needed. Camera metadata or filenames alone do not prove project ownership or customer permission.
- Permission/licence records for all supplied images, any identifiable people and any customer/site confidentiality remain to be verified by the owner. Original files can include metadata; review this before public publication.
- Chemical resistance, slip resistance, food-area suitability, ESD and dielectric claims are product/system-specific. Relevant pages now link to a document request and explicitly state that images/generic text are not performance evidence.
- No actual TDS, SDS or test-report files were supplied for publication. Do not add certification logos or guarantee performance from an image.

LAWYER / CA / SPECIALIST VERIFICATION REQUIRED
- Verify Shivam Vishvakarma’s owner-supplied identity and business constitution; no supporting business documents supplied. Udyam is confirmed unregistered; constitution remains pending CA advice.
- GST registration obligation, invoices, tax collection and record-retention obligations. Not registered does not mean registration is unnecessary.
- Reasonableness/enforceability of a 10% total-quotation cancellation charge in addition to material/transport deductions; avoid double recovery when materials are returned. Review the confirmed pre-purchase full refund within one week and post-purchase refund within 7–15 working days, including supplier-credit reconciliation.
- Warranty duration/start/coverage, moisture/surface exclusions, own-workmanship obligations and non-excludable consumer remedies.
- B2B MSA/work orders, milestones, DLP, shutdown/delay treatment, liability limits, NDA and dispute provisions. Surat jurisdiction cannot remove mandatory consumer forum rights.
- Product-specific TDS/SDS/test reports, electrical performance design/testing, food-area suitability and safety instructions.
- Site risk assessment, PPE, insurance type/coverage/dates. Insurance is site-specific; no blanket insured claim. ESIC/PF is reported unregistered; applicability and fulfilment of mandatory labour obligations must be resolved before relevant mobilisation.
- Privacy grievance contact, reasonable operational response targets, retention schedules and processor/log/back-up inventory. Applicable statutory deadlines prevail.
- DPDP Act/Rules phased commencement, IT Act/rules and consumer-law applicability; do not label the site fully DPDP compliant based on this code update.

OWNER-CONFIRMED POLICY UPDATE
- All seven policy/contact pages clarify that accepted quotation and matching warranty card contain final project-specific commercial/warranty conditions based on site, system, surface, use, area, operating conditions and customer requirements. Agreement is required before payment/work; privacy/cookie obligations and mandatory rights are not overridden. No unilateral reduction of agreed commitments. Lawyer should check contract document consistency and order of precedence.
- Suitable specification takes priority over unsupported low-budget guarantees; customers may compare preparation, materials and scope. Exact project warranty is recorded in the accepted quotation and matching warranty card. Website ranges are indicative. Inconsistencies require written clarification; later cards cannot unilaterally reduce agreed commitments, and mandatory rights remain unaffected. Lawyer should review the quotation/card template and warranty exclusions.
- Owner: Shivam Vishvakarma, trading as Shivam Epoxy Flooring; constitution unconfirmed, Udyam unregistered.

- B2B: 40% against purchase order, remaining milestones agreed in writing. Delay/shutdown extensions and pre-agreed waiting/revisit costs described; lawyer review required.
- Before material purchase: full refund within one week. After purchase: 7–15 working days, Bank transfer/UPI; supplier credits reconciled without double recovery. 10% total-quote charge still requires legal review.
- Grievance: Shivam Vishvakarma, Owner, existing business email. Privacy acknowledgment within 10 working days; eligible deletion/response within 30 days subject to legal exceptions.
